content_blocks.title: Apply the idea
content_blocks.text: Write the smallest DDL statement for this object, inspect its definition, and document a safe reset for the disposable lab. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code: WITH customers AS (SELECT 1 AS customer_id, 'Ari' AS customer_name UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Mina'), orders AS (SELECT 101 AS order_id, 1 AS customer_id, 40 AS total_amount UNION ALL SELECT 102, 1, 25) SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.total_amount FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY c.customer_id, o.order_id;
content_blocks.expected_output: Three result rows: Ari has two orders; Mina appears once with NULL order fields because LEFT JOIN preserves her customer row.
